scope.target: one lower 2x4 brick; overlap, orientation and rigid support to be fixed before identification
scope.approach: deterministic taught pose; residual policy acts only within a measured local mating envelope

frames_and_units.transform_convention: T_A_B maps coordinates in B into A
frames_and_units.EE: configured robot end-effector frame; retain saved F_T_EE
frames_and_units.K: configured stiffness frame; retain and log EE_T_K
frames_and_units.M: local lower-brick mating frame, +Z outward normal; teach/measure T_O_M
frames_and_units.held_brick: measure T_EE_brick and its repeatability; do not infer from commanded gripper width
frames_and_units.wrench: Franka estimated external wrench at K; rotate AND shift moment reference to M, subtract identified bias; preserve validity flags

control_contract.real_interface: joint position commands through existing libfranka joint impedance mode
control_contract.adapter: bounded residual XYZ and yaw in taught M -> deterministic IK/setpoint adapter; share implemented adapter/limiter/filter code, identify a surrogate of the inaccessible Franka embedded impedance loop
control_contract.action_semantics: absolute bounded offset about nominal handoff pose, not accumulated increments; supervisor clips the total envelope
control_contract.interpolation: host interpolates policy setpoints with the same commissioned continuous rate/acceleration/jerk limits in both domains; stale policy stops through supervisor
control_contract.ik_branch: seed from measured joints at handoff, preserve continuous branch, reject discontinuity or failed joint/singularity checks; no contact-time yaw-branch switching
control_contract.reset: policy history and residual reset only after deterministic supervisor establishes a fresh stationary handoff and valid grasp; no mid-contact reset
control_contract.roll_pitch: world-vertical tool only; no roll/pitch actions or silent constraint relaxation; demonstrate a limitation if this prevents seating
control_contract.simulation: dynamic articulation/contact with identified effective servo response, not q/dq overwrite or ideal pose teleportation
control_contract.travel_definition: maximum_action is the absolute residual envelope; maximum_total_travel is cumulative absolute commanded travel per axis, not displacement
control_contract.guard_owner: deterministic supervisor outside policy; missing commissioning limits disable real residual execution
control_contract.sdk_ownership: one foreground SDK owner; bounded callback telemetry fanout; no independent reader over controller
control_contract.note: residual_interface.py implements offline guarded targets only. No hardware controller or identified servo is provided; all null limits remain uncommissioned.

actor_observations: measured TCP pose/velocity relative to the same imperfect taught nominal mating frame in both domains, not exact simulated brick alignment
commanded setpoint error and previous residual action
bias-corrected estimated wrench at the specified reference, with age and validity
gripper measured width/state and bounded observation history
hidden_transform_randomization: perturb actual mating/grasp transforms without recentering actor observations on simulator truth; retain taught estimates visible on hardware

identification_log.timestamp: monotonic sample and command timestamps, sequence, elapsed time, drop/delay accounting
identification_log.singularity_caveat: installed libfranka documents estimated wrench as zero near/in singularities; never interpret this as no contact

brick_body_dimensions_m.source: operator supplied; height excludes studs; not precision metrology

stud_tube_interference_geometry.source: not measured; native BrickSim stud/tube visuals are not collision geometry

grip_pose_compliance_slip.source: modified pads not characterized under insertion loads

success_definition: expected seated relative geometry after unloading, no grasp/support slip, plus an independently established retention check; neither low TCP Z, force drop nor a simulated weld alone is success
acceptance_rule: Set tolerances from repeatability, sensor resolution and acceptable physical loads BEFORE fitting; reserve held-out trials. Do not fill unknowns with library defaults or randomize around an unvalidated model.
